label: Clause 17D Widows, minors whose fathers are deceased, and persons over 70. Exemption is the greater of $2000 in valuation, or $175 in tax.
Clause 22 Disabled/wounded veterans, or their wives, widows, or parents. Exemption varies from $2000 to $10000 in valuation, or $175 to $875 tax.
Clause 22E 100% disabled veterans, with annual Veterans' Administration Certificate.
Clause 37A Exemption for blind: $5000 valuation or $500 tax
Clause 41C Exemption for persons 70 or over; $4000 in valuation or $500 in tax, whichever is greater.
Clause 41A Tax deferral on domicile for certain persons 65 or older, with gross income less than $20000.
Clause 42 Unmarried widows of police/fire officers killed in line of duty. Exemption $8000 valuation or $700 tax, whichever is greater.
Clause 43 Minor orphans of police/fire officers killed in line of duty. Same exemption as Clause 42.
